app.title: Elena — Road to the BFA
app.tagline: Every deadline, audition, and requirement in one place.

nyc.label: New York City area
nyc.note: Four schools audition in/around NYC (Jan-Mar). One or two well-timed trips can cover several. Purchase is Westchester, ~35 min from Grand Central.

socal.label: Southern California
socal.note: USC (LA), LMU (Westchester, ~12 mi from USC) and Chapman (Orange, ~40 mi) are combinable into one Southern California trip. LMU's audition is video-only, so it needs no travel of its own.

boston.label: Boston
boston.note: Boston Conservatory offers a live-online audition — may avoid the flight.

tucson.label: Tucson, AZ
tucson.note: Video-only audition accepted, but an in-person Sept/Jan date (before ~Feb 1) preserves first-year Dance Merit talent aid.

lastRefresh.summary: Re-verified all 9 schools against live sources. Mostly a quiet week: Pace's Jan 3 → Jan 4 Sands pre-screen pendingChange reconfirmed for a second consecutive week (still not auto-accepted — needs a human to move proposedValue into value). Fordham/Ailey's apply page now shows "Applications have closed" and no longer displays the split Nov 6/Nov 8 dates behind last week's pendingChange, so that conflict remains unresolved. Arizona's BFA page yielded a minor new programFacts note (5-years-training / two-genre eligibility guidance). NYU Tisch, SUNY Purchase, LMU, USC Kaufman, Chapman, and Boston Conservatory's previously confirmed deadlines, fees, and audition dates all reconfirmed unchanged. Fordham's general fordham.edu pages remain bot-blocked (CAS login gateway).
